scenes.text: Every hour, millions of buildings consume energy. Lights, cooling, machines that run all night. And much of it is wasted, without anyone noticing.
A monthly bill tells you how much a building used. It never tells you how much it should have used. Without that benchmark, waste stays invisible, and savings stay unproven.
This is Baseline AI, developed by COMPILIX INNOVATIONS. It learns how each building behaves, from its meter, the weather and the calendar, and predicts its energy use, hour by hour.
Tested on five hundred and ninety-one real buildings, and more than nine million hourly readings, it cuts forecast error by forty percent compared with the standard baseline.
When a building uses more than it should, Baseline AI raises a flag. Equipment left running, a broken schedule, a failing system. Teams can act in days, not at the end of the year.
After an efficiency upgrade, it measures the real savings, adjusted for the weather. So investors and programmes know what actually worked.
No sensors to install. No engineering model for every building. One model covers an entire portfolio, from a single campus to a whole country.
For building owners, utilities, investors and governments, Baseline AI turns meter data into decisions, and decisions into energy saved.
Baseline AI. Know what every building should consume. Open source, and ready to pilot with your portfolio.
